responsibility: This header declares `Bvariable`, the Rust frontend wrapper for backend variable declarations, including special handling for zero-sized globals whose stored declaration type may differ from the type exposed to expressions. It provides the small shared data structure used between the abstract backend API and the GCC backend implementation in `rust-gcc.cc` when variables are created and later referenced.
same_name_distinction: Only declares the `Bvariable` helper class used by the backend, including storage of the actual decl and original type for zero-sized-variable handling. Unlike `rust-gcc.cc`, it does not implement the GCC backend or IR lowering; it just exposes the small shared wrapper that the `.cc` file's backend logic operates on.
